User.title: User Profile
User.description: The user progress, gold/crystals, levels, XP and achievements.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

perfectDays.description: Number of days where all quests were completed.

Quest.title: Quest
Quest.description: A habit or task tracked by the user, representing their daily quests.

title.description: Title of the quest (e.g., Drink 2L Water).

xpReward.description: Amount of XP awarded upon completion.

icon.description: Lucide icon name (e.g., Droplets, BookOpen, SmartphoneCharging).

streak.description: Current completion streak for this specific habit.

completed.description: Completion status for the current day.

isDefault.description: Whether this is a standard system quest.

ActivityLog.title: Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: Daily snapshot of user activity powering the calendar and history screens.

completedCount.description: Number of quests completed on this day.

totalCount.description: Total quests tracked on this day.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user statistics, levels, currency and personal profile details.

/users/{userId}/quests/{questId}.description: User's customized list of adventure quests and habits.

/users/{userId}/activity_logs/{dateStr}.description: Tracked completion scores for each calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) to power charts and heatmaps.
